# ml/datasets/processed/

This folder contains **cleaned and feature-engineered** data ready for model training.

## ⚠️ NOT committed to Git (see .gitignore)

Large processed files are gitignored. The pipeline auto-generates them.

## Generated by Pipeline

Running `python -m ml.pipeline.run_pipeline` or the cleaning notebooks will
populate this folder with processed CSV files.

## File Naming Convention

```
processed/
├── landslide_clean.csv          # After cleaning step
└── landslide_features.csv       # After feature engineering step
```
